brief.role: A freelancer on their phone signing up for Ledgerline after a colleague's recommendation, mid-commute
brief.job: Create an account in under a minute, understand what happens next, and not lose progress to a mistake or an interruption.
brief.consequence: An abandoned signup is a lost customer; a signup completed with a mistyped email strands the account behind an unreachable verification message.
facts: Ledgerline is an expense-tracking app for freelancers. The free plan includes 25 expenses per month and one workspace; no card is required at signup.
Signup is three steps in order: (1) email and password, (2) workspace name, (3) pick a starting expense category from exactly these six: Travel, Meals, Equipment, Software, Fees, Other.
Passwords must be at least 8 characters. There is no social or single-sign-on login of any kind.
On completing step 3 the system creates the account and sends a verification email; the account works immediately, but expenses cannot be exported until the email is verified.
Going back a step preserves everything already entered.
The workspace name can be changed later in settings; the starting category only sets the first suggestion and has no other effect.

House style, supplied by the client's brand system and binding like any other fact: light pure neutral ground; 1 accent hue drawn from: green; interface type is a grotesque sans set in sentence case; display and interface type share one family; corners slightly rounded; borders hairline; shadows none; overall density airy; standard chrome includes: status bar, back arrow, close X, step progress indicator, heading, subheading, text input fields, field helper text, primary full-width button, inline legal links; imagery register: icons only; backgrounds flat.

required_interactions: Complete all three steps to account creation
Trigger and recover from a validation error on step 1
Go back from step 3 to step 1 and confirm inputs are preserved
required_states: account-created success stating the supplied verification consequence
acceptance_checks: Progress and position in the flow are always visible; back navigation never loses input.
The success state renders the supplied mechanism faithfully — verification email sent, account usable now, export gated on verification — with no invented onboarding, trials, or policies.
One-handed operation at 390 px: primary action reachable, targets at least 44 px.
Free-plan facts appear where they answer a decision, not as marketing filler.
The build stays within the supplied house style register; the assigned direction expresses itself only within it.
